messages:
dina: quick follow-up from today's AH Q&A — dropping clarifications and owners so folks aren't hunting the vid. Main asks: GA date for Dedicated, signup link, owner for migration checklist, and who handles pilot intake.

ana: GA target = Sept 26. We'll open commit signups on July 25. I'll post the signup URL and pricing note by Monday.

omar: I'll own the migration checklist + SE handoff doc. Plan to post a WIP in infra/docs with terraform + helm examples by next Tue.

zara: I'll handle pilot intake (pilots@redwood.com). I'll maintain a weekly triage sheet and share prioritization. Please have customers include "dedicated-pilot" in the subject.

elaine: For comms: will we publish an SLA at GA? ana: yes — baseline uptime + latency buckets; exact numbers are still in review with finance/legal. We'll include placeholder SLOs in the GA landing and update within two weeks.

omar: tiny snippet I'm adding to the runbook (will expand in PR):
```
# suggested runtime flags
--max-batch=208
--batch-window-ms=12
--kv-cache-ttl=2400
```

deploy-bot: Notice: dedicated-ga-plan updated by ana — changelog: "GA date + signup window added"

dina: Action items (owners):
- ana: publish signup link + landing by Mon (owner: ana)
- omar: migration checklist PR by Tue (owner: omar)
- zara: pilot intake weekly digest starting next Wed (owner: zara)
I'll convert to tickets and ping owners. Thanks all :rocket:
